companies.name: FSB d.o.o.
companies.description: A leading Croatian company for passive fire protection. We specialize in the production of fire-rated doors and metalwork and in carrying out fire protection works in all types of buildings.

companies.name: FSB SOLUTIONS d.o.o.
companies.description: A sister company specialized in the distribution and technical support of premium-quality fire protection products. We represent leading European manufacturers and provide complete technical support.

jobs.title: Fire Protection Project Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced project manager to coordinate the execution of fire protection works on demanding projects throughout Croatia. Join our team and work on the most challenging projects in the region.
responsibilities: Planning and coordinating the execution of fire protection works
Leading the project team and cooperating with subcontractors
Communicating with investors and supervising engineers
Monitoring project progress and quality control
Ensuring deadlines and budgets are met
requirements: University degree in a technical field (civil engineering, mechanical engineering or similar)
Minimum 5 years of experience in project management

jobs.title: Firestopping Installer
jobs.description: We are looking for motivated installers for the installation of firestopping systems on construction projects. We offer training and certification for working with the latest materials and technologies.
responsibilities: Installing firestopping systems according to project documentation
Working with various types of penetrations (cables, pipes, mixed)
Complying with technical specifications and standards
Cooperating with the project manager and other team members
requirements: Secondary school education in a technical field
Experience in construction (preferably in fire protection)
Willingness to work at height and in confined spaces
benefits: Regular salary and per diems for field work

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Join our sales team as a sales engineer and present premium fire protection products to our clients. An ideal position for technical professionals with sales skills.
responsibilities: Developing and maintaining relationships with existing clients
Technical presentation of products and solutions
Participating in trade fairs and industry events
requirements: University degree in a technical field
Minimum 2 years of experience in technical sales
benefits: Work with leading brands in the industry
